chapter: Sam Morgan, repertoire and Silver Leaf
title: Hippolyte Charles, Sweet Emma and who ran the Silver Leaf
summary: He recalls Albert Baptiste ran the Silver Leaf, Hippolyte Charles and Sweet Emma may have been in it, and Henry Russ played with it.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: That's right. Yeah. So, did you say that you knew Hippolyte Charles? Yeah, very well. Did you play in the Silverleaf Band with him or before him or after him?

No, no, that was after him. Oh, after him. So that must have been, uh. You see, it was a different Silverleaf. It was a different man handling this thing. Well, who was handling it then? I don't know, no. But Albert Baptiste had it when I was, uh, playing with him. Yeah.
Well, I think he had it when Hippolyte Charles. He probably had it.
You know, I might be mixed up on it.

He had Silverleaf Band and Hippolyte Charles played with him. Now let's see, Arthur Williams. And this girl, I think, let me say before I forget about that, they call her Sweet Emma. Yeah. But I think she was playing with the Silverleaf one time, Hippolyte Charles was playing. Oh, Emma Farris.

I think she was. I'm not sure. Was she with the band when you came in? With the Silverleaf Band? No. She wasn't with the band. I think she was with them then. When she was with him? It does. With Albert Baptiste, Silverleaf Band. Yeah. I think she was with them when Hippolyte Charles was playing.
I guess she had gone on with Radzli by then. Probably so. She started with Radzli for years. Yeah.
Yeah. Ah, that's right. Talking about Silverleaf, what was the Silvertone Band then? I don't know. Was that one of your bands?
Well, when did Henry Russ mention that? He said he played in the Silvertone Band. He must have maybe, maybe he's mixed up on that.
He probably got mixed up on that. He played with Silverleaf. He played with the Silverleaf Band. Yeah, he played with us.
